title: Al-Ghashiyah 88:17-21 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ghashiyah, the makharij and the rules of laam
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ghashiyah 88:17-21 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 15. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ (١٧) وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ (١٨) وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ (١٩) وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ (٢٠) فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ (٢١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
And at the sky - how it is raised?
And at the mountains - how they are erected?
And at the earth - how it is spread out?
So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ghashiyah 88:17-21 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 88:17-21 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: 88:21: the Prophet ﷺ is told he is only ...
Listening rota: today's group recites 88:17-21 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write one thing you notice about a camel that shows Allah's wisdom.
questions.a: For example: it can go many days without water; wide feet walk on sand.

questions.q: Read 88:17 to 20 and count the sun and moon letters.
questions.a: Moon: ٱلْإِبِلِ, ٱلْجِبَالِ, ٱلْأَرْضِ (3). Sun: ٱلسَّمَآءِ (1).

questions.q: Which do 88:17 to 20 ask us to look at?
questions.a: A) Camels, sky, mountains, earth. 88:17 to 20 name the camels, the sky, the mountains and the earth.

questions.q: Al-Ghashiyah 88:19: «وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Look at a camel, the sky, the mountains and the ground. What could each of them teach you about Allah?
questions.a: Allah asks us to look at how the camel was created, how the sky was raised, how mountains were set and the earth spread (88:17 to 20).
